title: Rethinking Tool Design for Agentic RCA: A Controlled Empirical Study
title_zh: 重新思考智能体式根本原因分析（RCA）的工具设计：一项受控实证研究

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly explored for root cause analysis (RCA) in microservice systems, yet empirical guidance on how to design and combine their tools remains limited. We conduct a controlled empirical study of tool abstraction and composition across models and microservice environments. We implement 24 structured tools for metric access (L1), evidence analysis (L2), and diagnosis (L3), alongside a Python-based reference setting (L0). Using 375 failure cases from three microservice systems, we evaluate eight configurations with Qwen3.7-Plus and compare four Qwen models on a shared subset of four configurations. Our results show that tool configurations affect root cause localization and failure type identification differently. With Qwen3.7-Plus, L3 achieves 82.8% top-1 localization accuracy compared with 85.4% for L0, while requiring less than half the time per case. Adding tool levels can improve type identification while reducing localization accuracy. Trajectory analysis reveals cases in which agents override correct diagnostic recommendations after consulting additional evidence. Model choice also changes tool benefits: adding L3 to L1+L2 improves diagnosis for three models but hurts Qwen3-8B, which rarely invokes L3. Tool configuration rankings further change across microservice systems. These findings provide an empirical foundation for designing and using RCA tools, guiding tool selection and composition according to the model, diagnostic objective, and target system.

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly emerging as autonomous problem solvers for complex real world tasks ( Yao et al., 2022 ; Schick et al., 2023 ) . Root cause analysis (RCA) is a particularly promising application in AIOps, where identifying the entities and failure types behind system incidents requires iterative evidence collection and reasoning for timely mitigation and recovery ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Roy et al., 2024 ; Shetty et al., 2024 ) . Recent agentic RCA systems have explored multi-agent collaboration ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) , causal and structured reasoning ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) , SOP guided diagnosis ( Pei et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) , explicit reasoning state management ( Luo et al., 2026a ) , and memory augmented diagnosis ( Sun et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , substantially advancing automated RCA. Yet, across these efforts, one fundamental design choice remains largely unexplored: what tools should an RCA agent be given to extract useful information from massive metric streams? This question is critical as metric data in microservice systems is massive and noisy ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , while only a small fraction is relevant to the root cause. Existing systems broadly address this challenge in two ways: some rely on expert designed preprocessing to distill raw metrics into diagnostic signals ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) , while others allow agents to actively acquire and analyze metrics using a predefined toolset ( Pei et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2026a ; Sun et al., 2026 ) . Despite these efforts, none of these studies has systematically examined what analytical capabilities RCA tools should provide or how those capabilities should be combined.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体正迅速成为解决复杂现实任务的全自主问题求解器（Yao 等，2022；Schick 等，2023）。 根本原因分析（RCA）是 AIOps 中一个极具前景的应用领域，因为识别系统事件背后的实体和故障类型需要迭代收集证据并进行推理，以实现及时缓解和恢复（Chen 等，2024；Roy 等，2024；Shetty 等，2024）。 近期的智能体式 RCA 系统已探索了多智能体协作（Zhang 等，2024；Sun 等，2025；Luo 等，2025）、因果与结构化推理（Jiang 等，2026；Xie 等，2026）、SOP 引导的诊断（Pei 等，2025；Zhao 等，2026；Gao 等，2026）、显式推理状态管理（Luo 等，2026a）以及记忆增强诊断（Sun 等，2026；Zhang 等，2026），从而显著推动了自动化 RCA 的发展。 然而，在这些研究中，一个基本的设计选择仍 largely 未被探索：RCA 智能体应配备哪些工具，才能从海量指标流中提取有用信息？ 这个问题至关重要，因为微服务系统中的指标数据既庞大又充满噪声（Zhang 等，2025），而其中只有极小一部分与根本原因相关。 现有系统主要通过两种方式应对这一挑战：一些系统依赖专家设计的预处理流程，将原始指标提炼为诊断信号（Sun 等，2025；Luo 等，2025；Jiang 等，2026）；另一些系统则允许智能体通过预定义的工具集主动获取和分析指标（Pei 等，2025；Luo 等，2026a；Sun 等，2026）。 尽管已有这些努力，但上述研究均未系统性地探讨 RCA 工具应提供哪些分析能力，或这些能力应如何组合使用。

paragraphs.en: Through an analysis of how existing agentic RCA systems process metrics, we find that their tools already span different degrees of analytical responsibility. We capture this hierarchy with three tool levels: L1 tools retrieve raw metric data, L2 tools transform the data into diagnostic evidence through operations like anomaly detection or causal analysis, and L3 tools return diagnostic results. OpsAgent’s metric processor provides a concrete example of this progression: it retrieves target metric series within a specified time window (L1), applies the 3-sigma rule and temporal shape classification to detect anomalies (L2), and aggregates deviation scores to produce top-5 service instance and metric candidates corresponding to root cause entities and failure types (L3) ( Luo et al., 2025 ) . As the abstraction level increases, tools encode more domain knowledge and undertake a larger portion of the RCA process, which intuitively suggests that higher level tools should provide stronger support for diagnosis. However, does this intuition hold in practice?
paragraphs.zh: 通过分析现有智能体根因分析（RCA）系统处理指标的方式，我们发现其工具已经涵盖了不同层级的分析责任。 我们通过三个工具层级来体现这一层次结构：L1 工具负责获取原始指标数据；L2 工具通过异常检测或因果分析等操作将数据转化为诊断证据；L3 工具则返回诊断结果。 OpsAgent 的指标处理器为这一演进过程提供了具体实例：它会在指定时间窗口内获取目标指标序列（L1），应用 3-西格玛法则和时间形态分类法来检测异常（L2），并汇总偏差得分，生成与根本原因实体和故障类型相对应的 Top-5 服务实例和指标候选项（L3）（Luo 等，2025）。 随着抽象层级提升，工具会编码更多领域知识并承担根因分析过程中更大的一部分工作，这直观上表明更高层级的工具应为诊断提供更强的支持。 然而，这种直觉在实践中是否成立呢？

paragraphs.en: Answering this question requires more than comparing tool configurations in a single setting, because tool effectiveness may depend on both the agent that uses the tool and the environment in which diagnosis is performed. Models differ in their abilities to analyze data and use tools ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Patil et al., 2025 ) , while microservice systems differ substantially in scale, metric space, dependency structure, and failure propagation ( Pham et al., 2025 ; Liang et al., 2026 ) . We therefore study tool design together with these two contextual factors, conducting controlled experiments across tool abstraction and composition , model capability , and microservice system complexity . paragraphs.en: We derive an abstraction with three levels for structured RCA tools from representative agentic RCA systems and implement 24 structured tools spanning metric access, evidence analysis, and diagnostic methods, establishing a controlled experimental space for studying tool abstraction and composition.

paragraphs.en: We conduct a controlled empirical study across eight tool configurations, four Qwen models spanning distinct capability levels, and three RCAEval environments with different system architectures and complexity profiles, systematically examining the effects of tool abstraction and composition and their interactions with model capability and system complexity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在八种工具配置、四种能力水平各异的 Qwen 模型，以及三种系统架构和复杂度特征不同的 RCAEval 环境中，开展了一项受控的经验性研究，系统地考察了工具抽象与组合的影响，以及它们与模型能力和系统复杂度的相互作用。

paragraphs.en: We reveal that tool composition can have opposing effects on root cause localization and failure type identification, and that tool benefits depend on model capability and diagnostic environment. Through trajectory analysis, we identify failures in tool use and conflicts in evidence interpretation that help explain these differences. Together, these findings provide an empirical foundation for the design and use of tools in agentic RCA.

paragraphs.en: Metric Based Agentic RCA. In microservice systems, metric based agentic RCA is complicated by massive and noisy metric spaces along with failure propagation across dependent components, which can separate observed symptoms from their underlying causes ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2026 ) . For example, a frontend error may stem from memory exhaustion in an underlying service or node, illustrating how failure propagation can obscure the true source of an incident and require further evidence across components. Agentic RCA therefore treats diagnosis as an iterative investigation in which the agent forms hypotheses from available evidence, determines what additional information is needed, acquires and analyzes relevant metrics, then refines its diagnosis until it identifies the root cause entity and failure type ( Pei et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2026a ; Sun et al., 2026 ) . Since the complete metric space can easily exceed an LLM’s context window, the system must decide “what evidence to expose to the agent” and “how much analysis to delegate to its tools” .
paragraphs.zh: 基于指标的智能体根本原因分析。 在微服务系统中，基于指标的智能体根本原因分析（RCA）因庞大的噪声指标空间以及跨依赖组件的故障传播而变得复杂，这些因素可能导致观察到的症状与其根本原因脱节（Zhang et al., 2025；Fang et al., 2026）。 例如，前端错误可能源于底层服务或节点的内存耗尽，这说明了故障传播如何掩盖事件的真正来源，并需要跨组件收集更多证据。 因此，智能体根本原因分析将诊断视为一个迭代调查过程：智能体从可用证据中形成假设，确定需要哪些额外信息，获取并分析相关指标，然后不断修正诊断结果，直至识别出根本原因实体和故障类型（Pei et al., 2025；Luo et al., 2026a；Sun et al., 2026）。 由于完整的指标空间很容易超出大型语言模型（LLM）的上下文窗口限制，系统必须决定“向智能体暴露哪些证据”以及“将多少分析工作委托给其工具”。

paragraphs.en: Challenge 1: Fixed Preprocessing Creates an Evidence Bottleneck. Fixed preprocessing uses expert knowledge and statistical procedures to filter, aggregate, and rank metrics into compact diagnostic signals ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) . Although this reduces the search burden and provides salient evidence for diagnosis, it also fixes the evidence boundary before the root cause is known. If a signal needed to distinguish the true cause is excluded, subsequent reasoning cannot recover it, turning an efficiency mechanism into a potential evidence bottleneck.
paragraphs.zh: 挑战 1：固定的预处理会制造证据瓶颈。 固定预处理利用专家知识和统计程序，对指标进行筛选、聚合和排序，从而生成紧凑的诊断信号（Sun et al., 2025；Luo et al., 2025；Jiang et al., 2026）。 尽管这减轻了搜索负担并为诊断提供了显著证据，但它也会在根本原因尚未明确之前固定证据的边界。 如果某个用于区分真实原因的信号被排除在外，后续推理便无法恢复该信号，从而使一种效率机制转变为潜在的证据瓶颈。

paragraphs.en: Challenge 2: Tool Abstraction Creates an Analytical Tradeoff. Active metric access relaxes this fixed boundary by allowing agents to retrieve additional metrics as the diagnostic process unfolds ( Pei et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2026a ; Sun et al., 2026 ) . However, its effectiveness depends on the abstraction of the tools available to the agent. Basic tools mainly expose metric data, leaving anomaly detection and evidence association to the agent, whereas higher level tools perform more of this analysis and return processed diagnostic information. The former preserves greater analytical flexibility but places a heavier burden on the agent, while the latter reduces this burden but increases reliance on embedded analytical methods and may obscure intermediate evidence needed for verification.
paragraphs.zh: 挑战 2：工具抽象会引发分析权衡。 主动访问指标通过允许智能体在诊断过程展开时获取更多指标，从而打破了这一固定边界（Pei et al., 2025；Luo et al., 2026a；Sun et al., 2026）。 然而，其有效性取决于智能体可用工具的抽象程度。 基础工具主要提供指标数据，将异常检测和证据关联留给智能体处理，而更高级的工具则会执行更多此类分析，并返回经过处理的诊断信息。 前者保留了更大的分析灵活性，但给智能体带来了更重的负担；后者则减轻了这种负担，却增加了对内置分析方法的依赖，并可能掩盖验证所需的中间证据。

paragraphs.en: Challenge 3: Lack of Systematic Empirical Guidance. Existing agentic RCA methods typically evaluate a predefined toolset as part of a complete diagnostic system ( Luo et al., 2025 ; Pei et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2026a ; Sun et al., 2026 ) . Because tool design is coupled with preprocessing, prompts, agent workflows, and model choices, these evaluations cannot isolate its effect on diagnostic performance. They also provide limited evidence about whether the same configuration remains effective across models with different capabilities or microservice systems with different scale and complexity ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Patil et al., 2025 ; Pham et al., 2025 ; Liang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 挑战 3：缺乏系统性的实证指导。 现有的智能体根因分析方法通常将预定义的工具集作为完整诊断系统的一部分进行评估（Luo 等人，2025；Pei 等人，2025；Luo 等人，2026a；Sun 等人，2026）。 由于工具设计与预处理、提示、智能体工作流程和模型选择相互耦合，这些评估无法孤立地分析其对诊断性能的影响。 它们提供的证据也有限，无法说明相同的配置在不同能力的模型或规模和复杂度不同的微服务系统中是否仍然有效（Lu 等人，2025；Patil 等人，2025；Pham 等人，2025；Liang 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Our Study. We address these challenges through a controlled empirical study centered on RCA tool design. We construct tools with three different abstraction levels over the same underlying metric data and evaluate both individual levels and their combinations under a consistent agent setting. We further vary model capability and microservice system complexity to examine how the effectiveness of different tool configurations changes across diagnostic conditions. By separating tool design from other components of the agentic system, our study provides an empirical basis for understanding what tools should be provided to RCA agents and under what conditions.

paragraphs.en: Each run evaluates a model on a failure case under a specified tool configuration. We use a ReAct-style agent harness with a shared task prompt and configuration-specific interface instructions. The task prompt asks the agent to produce a final diagnosis containing ranked root cause candidates and a predicted failure type. A run ends when the agent submits a final diagnosis or reaches the interaction limit. We then evaluate the diagnostic output against the benchmark ground truth and derive tool-use and efficiency measurements from the execution records, using the metrics defined in Section 3.5 .

paragraphs.en: Tool abstraction. By analyzing the tool designs of representative agentic RCA systems ( e.g., OpsAgent ( Luo et al., 2025 ) , Flow-of-Action ( Pei et al., 2025 ) ), we derive a three-level abstraction of RCA tools. We distinguish these levels by their analytical responsibilities and outputs. L1 exposes metric observations, basic summaries, and system metadata; L2 analyzes metrics and returns results such as anomaly scores, temporal features, and metric relationships. L3 performs diagnosis-oriented analyses that produce root cause candidates or explanations. Inspired by OpenRCA ( Xu et al., 2025 ) , we further introduce L0 as a setting with no predefined RCA tools, where the agent is provided only with the same incident data and a general Python execution interface and must construct the entire analysis process on its own. paragraphs.en: Configuration design. We instantiate eight configurations, shown in Table 1 , to isolate the effects of metric access, evidence analysis, diagnostic methods, and their combinations. L0 captures analysis without predefined RCA tools, while the standalone L1, L2, and L3 configurations evaluate metric access, evidence analysis, and diagnostic methods, respectively. Because introducing any structured RCA tool changes the defining condition of L0, we evaluate L0 independently and construct compositions only among L1–L3. The three pairwise combinations examine complementarity between tool levels, while L1+L2+L3 assesses the effect of exposing the full structured toolset. By comparing configurations that differ by one tool level, we assess the contribution of L3 to lower-level toolsets and the value of adding L1 or L2 when L3 is already available. Together, these configurations allow us to study individual tool capabilities, complementarity across levels, and the effect of exposing the full structured toolset.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate all 375 failure cases in the RE1 suite of RCAEval ( Pham et al., 2025 ) , an open source benchmark for RCA in microservice systems. paragraphs.en: We organize the empirical results around the three study dimensions introduced in Section 3 . We first examine how tool abstraction and composition affect RCA under a fixed strong model (RQ1), and then study how these effects change with model capability (RQ2) and system complexity (RQ3). Within each RQ, we also analyze agent trajectories to explain the observed differences, and say that the agent considers a service when the service appears in its thoughts or tool inputs. We use AC@1 and TA as the primary metrics for root cause localization and failure type identification, and report AC@3, Avg@5, and efficiency metrics as complementary evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 我们围绕第 3 节中介绍的三个研究维度来组织实证结果。 我们首先考察在固定强模型下，工具抽象和组合如何影响 RCA（RQ1），然后研究这些效应如何随模型能力（RQ2）和系统复杂性（RQ3）而变化。 在每个研究问题中，我们还分析了智能体的轨迹以解释观察到的差异，并指出当服务出现在智能体的思考或工具输入中时，该智能体就会考虑使用此服务。 我们将 AC@1 和 TA 作为根本原因定位和故障类型识别的主要指标，并将 AC@3、Avg@5 和效率指标作为补充证据进行报告。

paragraphs.en: Higher abstraction helps both targets, but at different levels. Among the standalone structured configurations, AC@1 rises from 52.7% with L1 to 68.8% with L2 and 82.8% with L3 (Figure 3 (a)). L3 comes within 2.6 percentage points of L0, the most accurate configuration at 85.4%, and exceeds it in AC@3 and Avg@5. TA instead jumps from 24.3% with L1 to 44.4% with L2 and barely moves with L3 (45.6%; Figure 3 (b)). L0, which localizes best, identifies failure types worse (41.4%) than every configuration with L2 or L3. This ordering does not hold in every system: in AC@1, L2 falls below L1 on Sock Shop and exceeds L3 on Online Boutique, a dependence we examine in RQ3.
paragraphs.zh: 更高层级的抽象对两个目标都有帮助，但作用层次不同。 在独立的结构化配置中，AC@1 从 L1 的 52.7% 上升到 L2 的 68.8%，再到 L3 的 82.8%（图 3 (a)）。 L3 与最准确配置 L0（85.4%）的差距在 2.6 个百分点以内，并且在 AC@3 和 Avg@5 上超过了 L0。 相比之下，TA 从 L1 的 24.3% 跃升至 L2 的 44.4%，而在 L3 时几乎没有变化（45.6%；图 3 (b)）。 局部化效果最佳的 L0，在识别故障类型方面的表现（41.4%）比所有使用 L2 或 L3 的配置都要差。 这种排序并非在所有系统中都成立：在 AC@1 中，L2 在 Sock Shop 上的表现低于 L1，而在 Online Boutique 上则超过了 L3；我们将在 RQ3 中研究这种依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: Combining levels rarely helps localization but never hurts type identification. In AC@1, a combination rarely improves on its strongest constituent. Adding L3 improves every configuration that lacks it, by 9.4 to 30.9 points, and adding L1 changes AC@1 by at most 4.8 points in either direction. paragraphs.en: Beyond L3, additional levels add cost with little return. Figure 4 relates AC@1 to token and time consumption. In both panels, only L3, L1+L3, and L0 lie on the effectiveness–efficiency frontier, and every other configuration is both less accurate and more costly than at least one of them. L3 is the cheapest configuration, requiring 22.8K tokens and 35.8 seconds per case. L1+L3 gains 0.8 points for roughly twice the tokens, and L0 gains 2.6 points at 2.5 times the latency, because the agent must write and execute its own analysis. Adding L2 to L3 instead increases token consumption 3.5-fold while lowering AC@1. For TA, L0 drops off the frontier, since L3 identifies failure types more accurately at lower cost. Adding one level to L3 raises TA by 2.0 (L1) or 3.0 (L2) points, and the full toolset gains 3.4 points over L3 at 4.2 times the tokens.

paragraphs.en: Why do combinations not add up for localization? We compare the four configurations with L3 and call the top candidate of the first L3 ranking in a trajectory its L3 candidate . Additional levels change how the investigation starts but not what L3 returns. With L2+L3, the agent begins with anomaly filtering in 91% of trajectories rather than with the L3 ranking. Yet on the same case, L3 and L2+L3 return the same candidate in 99.9% of trajectory pairs that obtain one, as do L1+L3 and L1+L2+L3. This candidate is correct in more than 80% of trajectories in every configuration (Figure 5 ). The accuracy differences therefore arise after L3 returns, when the agent decides whether to keep the candidate.

paragraphs.en: We call a trajectory a correction when its L3 candidate is wrong but its final diagnosis is correct, and an override in the opposite case. Overrides outnumber corrections in every configuration, so adopting the L3 candidate directly would have been more accurate. Additional levels shift this balance in opposite directions. With L1+L3, the agent calls L1 after the L3 ranking in 98.5% of trajectories, mostly to inspect the ranked candidates. This verification doubles corrections from 2.7% to 5.3% of trajectories, while overrides rise only from 4.2% to 5.8%. L2 instead supplies competing evidence, such as the metrics that its candidate filtering ranks as most anomalous, and the agent sometimes abandons the L3 candidate for the entity this evidence points to. paragraphs.en: Why does type identification remain difficult? paragraphs.en: Why does L3 help some models but not others? A tool level improves the diagnosis insofar as the agent delegates analysis to it, calls it properly, and keeps its correct results. Figure 8 shows that the models fall short at different points. Qwen3-8B falls short at delegation, obtaining an L3 ranking in almost no trajectory. Like the other Qwen3 models, it often searches on its own before any tool proposes a candidate, inspecting services one by one from the entry service (43–78% of trajectories across the three Qwen3 models), which requires only metric access. Qwen3.7-Plus never does so and instead starts by filtering candidate metrics across the whole case. The decline of Qwen3-8B after L3 is added therefore does not come from L3 outputs. Instead, the larger toolset disrupts its own search: its trajectories grow from 10.1 to 11.7 steps on average and contain more invalid actions, such as malformed tool calls, and the decline concentrates on Sock Shop, where its AC@1 drops by 33.9 points.

paragraphs.en: The models that do call L3 fall short at later points. paragraphs.en: Train Ticket is the hardest system for localization, but not for type identification. paragraphs.en: Why does the effect of L2 reverse across systems? The per-system panels of Figure 5 show how L2 changes the agent’s decision on the L3 candidate. On Sock Shop and Train Ticket, adding L2 to L3 raises overrides from 3.5% of trajectories to 12.0% and 13.6%, respectively. On Online Boutique, it instead lowers overrides from 5.6% to 2.4% and nearly triples corrections, so that the agent’s decision improves on the L3 candidate. The difference lies in whether the entity that L2 ranks as most anomalous is the root cause. When this entity differs from the L3 candidate and the agent switches to it, the switch is correct in 79% of cases on Online Boutique but in only 5% on Sock Shop and Train Ticket. That L2 still raises TA on these systems suggests that its evidence often reveals what kind of fault occurred even when it points to the wrong entity. sents.en: With its most accurate structured toolset, L1+L3, Qwen3.7-Plus still selects a wrong root cause in 16.4% of cases, and its TA never exceeds 49.0%.

sents.en: We examine its failed trajectories under the configurations with L2 or L3.
sents.zh: 我们研究了在采用 L2 或 L3 配置时，模型出现失败的具体过程。

paragraphs.en: The agent finds the root cause but does not keep it. Qwen3.7-Plus completes every case, considers the true root cause in at least 96% of trajectories, and receives a correct top L3 candidate in more than 80% of the trajectories with an L3 ranking. Yet the agent had considered the true root cause in 84–95% of trajectories with incorrect localizations, indicating that localization failures arise mainly during the final decision rather than the search. Two patterns recur. The agent mistakes a service affected by the fault for its source, which is how L2 leads it away from correct L3 candidates on Sock Shop and Train Ticket (RQ1, RQ3). In a Train Ticket case with a delay fault in ts-auth-service , L3 ranked the correct service first, but candidate filtering ranked a memory metric of the payment service highest; finding no CPU or memory anomaly in the auth service, the agent treated its latency as a propagated symptom and blamed the payment service. The agent also uses tools to confirm rather than test a hypothesis: the evidence chain interface gathers observations that support a given candidate, and when that candidate is wrong, the agent keeps it in 83% of such calls.

paragraphs.en: The agent names the fault after its most prominent symptom. Type identification fails more often than localization: when Qwen3.7-Plus locates the root cause, it names the failure type correctly in only 55.7% of such trajectories under L1+L2+L3 and 45.9% under L0. The agent infers the failure type from anomalous metrics highlighted in the tool outputs. Since failure propagation makes CPU and latency anomalies prominent whatever the injected fault, these metrics point to the symptom rather than the fault: even with L3, disk faults are identified in only 4.0% of trajectories, and packet loss is almost never identified (RQ1). More evidence shifts these errors rather than removing them, as the full toolset identifies memory and disk faults more often but delay faults less often than L0 (50.2% vs. 84.4%).

paragraphs.en: Both failures call for tools that discriminate between explanations. In both cases, the agent must choose between explanations that the evidence fits equally well: the source of a fault versus the services it propagates to, and one failure type versus another with the same symptoms. Tools that rank evidence by how anomalous it is leave this choice unresolved, consistent with the small gains from adding levels beyond L3 (RQ1). For capable models, tools that seek counter-evidence or rank evidence by how well it separates failure types are thus more promising than tools that add analysis. Weaker models fail earlier: they leave more cases unfinished (Table 4 ) and, under L0, never consider the root cause in 41–51% of trajectories. They benefit first from a small and robust tool interface.
paragraphs.zh: 这两种失败都需要能够区分不同解释的工具。 在这两种情况下，智能体都必须在证据同样支持的多个解释之间做出选择：故障源与其传播的服务之间，以及具有相同症状的不同故障类型之间。 那些根据证据的异常程度进行排序的工具无法解决这一选择问题，这与在 L3 以上增加层级所带来的微小收益（RQ1）是一致的。 对于能力较强的模型而言，那些寻求反证或根据证据区分故障类型的效果对证据进行排序的工具，比单纯增加分析步骤的工具更有前景。 较弱的模型会提前失效：它们会让更多案例处于未完成状态（表 4），并且在 L0 条件下，有 41%–51% 的轨迹从未考虑根本原因。 它们首先会从一个小而稳健的工具接口中受益。

paragraphs.en: Internal validity. Our implemented toolset covers representative RCA capabilities across abstraction levels, and each function was unit-tested to verify its intended behavior. While these tools support the comparisons in our study, they do not cover the full range of RCA tools within each abstraction level. We also compare tool abstraction levels and their combinations within a common agent harness, allowing the agent to select individual interfaces during diagnosis. The results therefore characterize the overall effects of the evaluated tool configurations, while broader tool coverage and finer-grained attribution to specific interfaces within each level remain directions for further investigation.
paragraphs.zh: 内部效度。 我们实现的工具集涵盖了不同抽象层级的代表性根本原因分析（RCA）能力，并且每个功能都经过了单元测试，以验证其预期行为。 虽然这些工具支持我们研究中的比较，但它们并未涵盖每个抽象层级中所有类型的根本原因分析工具。 我们还在一个通用的智能体框架内比较了工具的抽象层级及其组合，使智能体能够在诊断过程中选择特定的接口。 因此，这些结果描述了所评估工具配置的整体影响，而更广泛的工具覆盖范围以及对各层级内特定接口的更精细归因，仍然是未来研究的方向。

paragraphs.en: External validity. We evaluate all 375 RE1 cases across three microservice systems and five injected failure types, providing coverage across different benchmark environments. This coverage supports comparisons within the benchmark, but production incidents and diagnosis incorporating logs and traces remain outside our experimental scope. In addition, our model comparison covers four models from the Qwen lineage, allowing us to examine capability differences within a common family. However, the applicability of these findings beyond the Qwen family has not yet been assessed. Extending this comparison to other model families therefore remains a direction for future study.

paragraphs.en: Agentic RCA for microservice systems. Agentic RCA systems adopt different strategies for providing analytical support and organizing tool use. Preprocessing-based approaches encapsulate operations such as telemetry filtering, anomaly detection, and candidate scoring in predefined pipelines, allowing agents to reason over the resulting evidence ( Luo et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2025 ) . Code-based approaches provide a general execution interface through which agents implement data retrieval and analysis, as exemplified by OpenRCA’s RCA-agent and reflected in our L0 setting ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . Workflow-guided approaches use SOPs and structured operational knowledge to organize tool invocation and code generation ( Pei et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) . Reasoning-oriented approaches employ agent collaboration, search, explicit states, or memory to guide evidence acquisition and the interpretation of tool results ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Naakka et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026b ) . However, these studies primarily evaluate tool support within specific diagnostic frameworks, providing limited guidance on how tool abstraction and composition affect diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: 面向微服务系统的智能体根因分析。 智能体根因分析系统在提供分析支持和组织工具使用方面采用了不同策略。 基于预处理的方案将遥测数据过滤、异常检测和候选项评分等操作封装在预定义的流程中，使智能体能够基于由此产生的证据进行推理（Luo 等，2025；Sun 等，2025；Tang 等，2025）。 基于代码的方案提供了一个通用的执行接口，智能体可通过该接口实现数据检索与分析，OpenRCA 的 RCA-agent 即为此类方案的代表，我们的 L0 设置也体现了这一点（Xu 等，2025）。 基于工作流引导的方案利用标准作业程序和结构化操作知识来组织工具调用和代码生成（Pei 等，2025；Gao 等，2026）。 以推理为导向的方案通过智能体协作、搜索、显式状态或记忆来指导证据获取以及对工具结果的解读（Zhang 等，2024；Naakka 等，2026；Luo 等，2026a；Zhang 等，2026；Sun 等，2026；Luo 等，2026b）。 然而，这些研究主要评估了特定诊断框架内的工具支持，对于工具抽象与组合如何影响诊断这一问题，仅提供了有限的指导。

paragraphs.en: Empirical studies of RCA and tool use. RCA benchmarks provide the experimental basis for comparing diagnostic methods across microservice systems, telemetry sources, and fault propagation scenarios ( Pham et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2026 ) . Beyond RCA, tool-use benchmarks assess whether models can retrieve appropriate tools, invoke APIs correctly, and complete multi-step interactions ( Li et al., 2023 ; Qin et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Patil et al., 2025 ) . Controlled studies address tool design more directly, comparing interface organization under similar capabilities in coding agents and examining tool complexity and composition in web agents ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Lou et al., 2026 ) . Extending these evaluations to the division of analytical work in RCA, our study compares the diagnostic value of tools that provide observations, analytical evidence, or root cause recommendations, individually and in combination.

paragraphs.en: We conducted a controlled empirical study of tool abstraction and composition for agentic RCA across different models and microservice systems. Our results show that tool configurations affect root cause localization and failure type identification differently. With the strongest evaluated model, L3 diagnostic tools offer a favorable balance between localization accuracy and cost. Adding tool levels improves overall failure type identification, but can reduce localization accuracy. These benefits also depend on the model: adding L3 to L1+L2 improves localization for three of the four models, but reduces it for the weakest model. Even with the same model, the relative performance of tool configurations changes across microservice systems. Together, these findings provide an empirical foundation for designing and using RCA tools, guiding practitioners to select tool abstraction and composition according to the diagnostic objective, model capability, and target system.
